## What's new

### Plugin marketplace
**Settings → Plugins** now has two tabs:
- **Marketplace:** the plugins listed at [larvyn.dev/plugins](https://larvyn.dev/plugins/), with search. Click **Install**, and Larvyn downloads the plugin, checks it matches the marketplace's checksum, and shows what it may do before installing it. The first listings are Mailpit, Horizon and Hello.
- **Installed:** every installed plugin, from the marketplace, a folder or a .zip. When a marketplace plugin has a new version, its row shows **Update**, and the tab shows how many updates there are.

Only plugins installed from the marketplace get updates, so a plugin you're developing in a folder is never overwritten. An update turns the plugin on, and keeps the projects you turned it off in and the commands you already confirmed. If an update asks for a new permission, Larvyn shows it and installs the update only once you approve.

### Plugin icons
A plugin can ship an `icon.svg` next to its `larvyn.json`. Larvyn shows it in Settings → Plugins and the marketplace. Plugins without one keep the puzzle piece.

### Revoked plugins
If the marketplace finds a plugin harmful, it can revoke it. Larvyn checks when it starts and when the marketplace opens. A revoked version is turned off, shows why, and can't be turned on or installed again from anywhere. Offline, Larvyn can't learn of new revocations, but the ones it already recorded keep blocking those versions.

## Fixed
- **macOS:** the Larvyn logo and name are back at the top left of the window.

## For plugin authors
Each example plugin now has a README page and an icon. See [larvyn/plugin-examples](https://github.com/larvyn/plugin-examples), and [larvyn/plugins](https://github.com/larvyn/plugins) to list yours.
